# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Poland 1970 scripted triggers
## Generated by pol_build.py (COLDWAR_POL generator) from the approved design of 15.11.2026. Edit the generator or the design, not this file.

# AI path: historical = Publish the New Price List, After the Coast, The Party Decides, The Silesian Takes Over and
# the Gierek tree (owner decision 15.11.2026).
COLDWAR_POL_ai_historical_path = {
	is_historical_focus_on = yes
}

# Power focuses: the AI hands power over once (the army may still take over in a crisis).
COLDWAR_POL_ai_handover_blocked = {
	is_ai = yes
	has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_handover_done
}

# The AI lets the army take over only in a crisis: Social Discontent 70 or more.
COLDWAR_POL_ai_unrest_crisis = {
	check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_POL_unrest value = 70 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
}

# A Catholic Nation: the Party and Church balance stands at 0.6 or more (shadow variable of the balance).
COLDWAR_POL_church_floor = {
	check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_POL_bop_shadow value = 0.6 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
}

# Poland is under Western sanctions: a Western-aligned country (Cold War alignment 1, mdcw_cw_alignment) holds one
# of the four Imperia sanction classes on Poland, or the American sanction decision stands.
COLDWAR_POL_under_sanctions = {
	OR = {
		any_of_scopes = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
		any_of_scopes = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
		any_of_scopes = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
		any_of_scopes = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
		AND = { country_exists = USA USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_us_sanctions } }
	}
}

				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = HLS }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = HLS }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = HLS }
			}
		}
	}
	HLS = {
		NOT = { is_embargoing = POL }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = POL }
			}
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_active = {
	COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_pair_clear = yes
	POL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_signed }
	HLS = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_consent }
}
COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_can_accept = {
	tag = HLS
	has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_pending
	NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_consent }
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_POL_offer_sender_tt
		has_variable = COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_sender
		var:COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_sender = { tag = POL }
	}
	country_exists = POL
	POL = {
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_open
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_signed }
	}
	COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_pair_clear = yes
}
COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_answer_valid = {

	COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_pair_clear = yes

				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = HLS }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = HLS }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = HLS }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = HLS }

				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = POL }

# Partner scope: a creditor or debtor of a running repayment (its ledger runs even after the agreement ended).
COLDWAR_POL_is_repay_partner = {
	country_exists = POL
	OR = {
		AND = { original_tag = SOV POL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_rouble_rescheduling_repay } }
		AND = { original_tag = CUB POL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_sugar_for_ships_repay } }
		AND = { original_tag = GER POL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_bonn_package_repay } }
		AND = { original_tag = GER POL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_coal_for_credit_repay } }
		AND = { original_tag = GER POL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_german_banks_repay } }
		AND = { original_tag = USA POL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_ccc_grain_repay } }
		AND = { original_tag = USA POL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_pl480_deferral_repay } }
		AND = { original_tag = ITA POL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_fiat_licence_repay } }
		AND = { original_tag = FRA POL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_french_protocol_repay } }
		AND = { original_tag = FRA POL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_giscard_accord_repay } }
		AND = { original_tag = FRA POL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_paris_club_repay } }
		AND = { original_tag = FRA POL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_fra_reschedule_repay } }
	}
}

# ---- Decisions of other countries: Poland may still accept (country exists, no war, embargo or sanction) ----
COLDWAR_POL_relations_clear_SOV = {
	country_exists = SOV
	NOT = { has_war_with = SOV }
	POL = {
		NOT = { is_embargoing = SOV }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
			}
		}
	}
	SOV = {
		NOT = { is_embargoing = POL }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = POL }

				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = POL }

	}

				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = FRA }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = FRA }
			}
		}
	}
	FRA = {
		NOT = { is_embargoing = POL }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = POL }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = POL }
			}
		}
	}
}
